generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exploratory 16:9 game cover for a modern 2D side-scrolling game
Primary request: Create an original cover for The Sky Remembers. Show exactly one non-sexualized
18-year-old final-year female student in a modest navy-and-white summer uniform, loafers, and a
canvas school satchel. Her missing younger brother's faded red scarf is tied to the satchel and
moves in the wind beside a tiny brass bell charm.
Composition variation: Silent level crossing. Show the student in clear side profile, paused at a
modern rural railway crossing whose warning lights glow but whose scene feels uncannily silent. No
train is present. The rails cut horizontally across rice fields toward a distant school and low
modern homes. Crossing poles and overhead wires frame rather than obscure the immense blue sky.
Keep the horizon low, with monumental sunlit cumulus occupying most of the frame; hide a single
half-dissolved rooftop shape inside one cloud bank.
Style/medium: Original luminous pastoral pixel painting with decisive graphic shadow bands, clean
coherent pixel clusters, crisp silhouette edges, restrained texture, sparse dithering, and minimal
outline. Modern high-color pixel art, not strict retro and not smooth digital painting.
Mood/palette: Flawless late-summer blue, warm fields, cream highlights, lavender cloud shadows,
cool distant town, faded red scarf; ordinary beauty interrupted by quiet absence.
Constraints: Wide side-view cover. Contemporary era. One person only. Non-sexual presentation.
Original brand-neutral scene. No text, pseudo-text, signage words, logos, insignia, signatures,
watermarks, UI, borders, copied landmarks, recognizable franchises, medieval cues, fantasy outfit,
fetishized uniform details, childlike anatomy, weapons, monsters, or extra companions.

visual_review.authority_basis: reviewer independent from the concept and prompt authors, provider operator, candidate selector, and deterministic WebP transform producer; exact final preview inspection against the selected PNG
visual_review.acceptance_spec: Exact The Sky Remembers premise; contemporary rural Japanese-inspired town; one non-sexualized proportional 18-year-old female student; silent level crossing; red scarf and brass bell story cues; immense blue sky and luminous pastoral pixel painting; strong 16:9 side-view cover; no readable or pseudo text, logo, signature, watermark, protected character or material, medieval cue, sexualization, childlike anatomy, weapon, monster, extra companion, or objectionable WebP artifact.
